{{Locations|Mantis Homeworlds|LRSmap=ship|unique=true}}


This is the [[The_Mantis_Cruiser#Layout_A|Mantis Cruiser]] ship unlocking event. <span style="color:grey">(the ship can also be unlocked by winning the game with the Zoltan Cruiser)</span>

:If this event is encountered without the required systems, you can jump away from the beacon, upgrade or buy the systems, and return to accomplish the quest.
----


''You cross paths with a Mantis ship that looks to have had dozens of layers of armor-plating added over what must have been a hundred year career. Its captain is legendary thief KazaaakplethKilik. Your crew look frightened.''

# {{Blue Option|Mantis crewmember|Attempt to hail him.|shortreq=Mantis Crew}}
#* ''Your Mantis crew-member steps forward. He and KazaaakplethKilik perform a weird kind of alien haka. You, meanwhile, charge the battle systems.''
#** [[#Fight the ship|'''Fight the ship''']] with crew entirely composed of Mantis. <ref name="Enemy ship (MANTIS_NAMED_THIEF)">{{SurrenderEscape(alt)|no|MANTIS_NAMED_THIEF|events_ships.xml}}</ref>
# Prepare to fight
#* [[#Fight the ship|'''Fight the ship''']] with crew entirely composed of Mantis. <ref name="Enemy ship (MANTIS_NAMED_THIEF)" />

==Fight the ship==
* {{Winning|destroyed=true|KazaaakplethKilik fights to the last, and you pick the scraps from the corpse of his ship. You sense, though, that his death has left a great mystery unresolved.}}
** You receive medium [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].
* {{Winning|deadCrew=true|No more life signs are detected aboard their ship.  You appear to have won.}}
*# Move in to strip their ship.
*#* ''It seems almost a waste for such a fierce foe to die in such an anticlimactic fashion. You shrug it off and take what you can.''
*#** You receive high [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].
*# {{Blue Option|Teleporter|Quickly teleport additional crew and check for survivors.}}
*#* ''You find KazaaakplethKilik slumped in a corner dying.''
*#*# Put him out of his misery.
*#*#* ''Thus ends the life of the famed captain, KazaaakplethKilik... You wonder what secrets went with him to the grave as you thoroughly loot his ship.''
*#*#** You receive high [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].
*#*# Listen to what he has to say.
*#*#* ''In his dying moments he gives up the location of his secret stash. You strip the ship wondering what other secrets went with him to the grave.''
*#*#** You receive high [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]] and a [[#Quest Marker|'''quest marker''']] is added to your map.
*#*# {{Blue Option|Adv. Medbay|Quickly teleport him back to the medbay.|level=2+|shortreq=Medbay}}
*#*#* [[#Save the thief|'''Save the thief''']].
*#*# {{Blue Option|Adv. Clonebay|Quickly configure the Clonebay to save him.|level=2+|shortreq=Clone Bay}}
*#*#* [[#Save the thief|'''Save the thief''']].
*# {{Blue Option|Sensors|Quickly scan their ship for survivors.|level=3|shortreq=Sensors}}
*#* ''You detect KazaaakplethKilik slumped in a corner dying.''
*#*# Let him die.
*#*#* ''Thus ends the life of the famed captain, KazaaakplethKilik... You wonder what secrets went with him to the grave as you thoroughly loot his ship.''
*#*#** You receive high [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].
*#*# Dock and try to speak with him.
*#*#* ''In his dying moments he gives up the location of his secret stash. You strip the ship wondering what other secrets went with him to the grave.''
*#*#** You receive high [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]] and a [[#Quest Marker|'''quest marker''']] is added to your map.
*#*# {{Blue Option|Adv. Medbay|Dock and quickly take him back to the medbay.|level=2+|shortreq=Medbay}}
*#*#* [[#Save the thief|'''Save the thief''']].
*#*# {{Blue Option|Adv. Clonebay|Quickly configure the Clonebay to save him.|level=2+|shortreq=Clone Bay}}
*#*#* [[#Save the thief|'''Save the thief''']].

===<h2><span style=font-size:smaller;>Save the thief</span></h2>===
* ('''Adv. Medbay''') ''Your haste has paid off and you are able to bring him back from the brink of death. When his senses return he says, "I never thought I would see this day, but... I am willing to devote myself and my ships to your cause."''<br />('''Adv. Clonebay''') ''Your haste has paid off and you register him into the Clonebay's database. After he passes away he is quickly reconstructed on board your ship. When his senses return he says, "I never thought I would see this day, but... I am willing to devote myself and my ships to your cause."''
** Accept.
***''KazaaakplethKilik joins your crew, offers the coordinates for a nearby stash of stolen military goods and transmits the coordinates for a custom cruiser he has been working on. You forward it to the Federation, sure they can make good use of it.''
**** You unlock the [[The Mantis Cruiser|Mantis Cruiser]]; receive high [[Rewards#Scrap_only|scrap]], [[Augmentations#Mantis_Pheromones|<span style="color:limegreen">Mantis Pheromones</span>]] augmentation, <span style="color:limegreen">Mantis crewmember</span> named Kazaaak maxed in all skills, and a [[#Quest Marker|'''quest marker''']] is added to your map.

==Quest Marker==
:{{Long-Ranged Scanners info|shipdetected=noship}}
''You arrive at small asteroid field and discover the hidden cache among the debris. You input the codes given to you by KazaaakplethKilik and find a weapon inside.''
* You receive a <span style="color:limegreen">weapon</span> with high <span style="color:#70b8ff">scrap</span>.

==Notes==
This event is called "MANTIS_NAMED_THIEF" in the datafiles.
